en.setup_title: Universal Runtime needs one setup step
en.unsupported_title: This PC needs a compatibility change
en.setup_subtitle: Startup tasks that can be fixed automatically stay hidden. Only items that need you are shown here.
en.EDGE_INSTALL_REQUIRED: Microsoft Edge is required to open the Universal Runtime app window.
en.WSL2_ENABLE_OR_INSTALL_REQUIRED: Windows Linux support (WSL 2) needs one setup step. A restart may be required.
en.DOCKER_DESKTOP_INSTALL_REQUIRED: Docker Desktop is required for the local services. You may need to accept Docker terms on first launch.
en.DOCKER_DESKTOP_START_NEEDS_ATTENTION: Docker Desktop is installed but needs one-time attention. Open Docker Desktop and complete any first-run or license step, then try again.
en.RUNTIME_BUNDLE_REPAIR_REQUIRED: The Universal Runtime local runtime is missing and needs product repair.
en.PRODUCT_STACK_REPAIR_REQUIRED: The Universal Runtime local service bundle is incomplete and needs product repair.
en.RUNTIME_START_FAILED: The Universal Runtime background service could not start automatically. Product repair is required.
en.PRODUCT_SERVICES_START_FAILED: The Universal Runtime local services could not start automatically. Product repair is required.
en.PRODUCT_HTTP_NOT_READY: Universal Runtime started its local services, but the app did not become ready in time.
en.PORT_19093_CONFLICT: Another program is using the local Runtime port. Close the conflicting program, then try again.
en.WINDOWS_UNSUPPORTED: This Windows version is not supported by the current Universal Runtime build.

zh-Hans.starting_docker: 正在启动 Docker Desktop 本地引擎...
zh-Hans.starting_services: 正在启动 Universal Runtime 本地服务...
zh-Hans.setup_title: Universal Runtime 需要完成一个设置步骤
zh-Hans.unsupported_title: 这台电脑需要调整兼容性设置
zh-Hans.setup_subtitle: 能自动处理的启动任务会自动完成。这里只显示确实需要你处理的项目。
zh-Hans.EDGE_INSTALL_REQUIRED: 需要 Microsoft Edge 才能打开 Universal Runtime 应用窗口。
zh-Hans.WSL2_ENABLE_OR_INSTALL_REQUIRED: 需要启用 Windows Linux 支持（WSL 2）。这个步骤可能需要重启电脑。
zh-Hans.DOCKER_DESKTOP_INSTALL_REQUIRED: 本地服务需要 Docker Desktop。首次启动时可能需要你确认 Docker 使用条款。
zh-Hans.DOCKER_DESKTOP_START_NEEDS_ATTENTION: Docker Desktop 已安装，但需要你完成一次初始设置或许可确认，然后再重试。
zh-Hans.RUNTIME_BUNDLE_REPAIR_REQUIRED: Universal Runtime 的本地运行组件缺失，需要修复产品安装。
zh-Hans.PRODUCT_STACK_REPAIR_REQUIRED: Universal Runtime 的本地服务组件不完整，需要修复产品安装。
zh-Hans.RUNTIME_START_FAILED: Universal Runtime 后台服务未能自动启动，需要修复。
zh-Hans.PRODUCT_SERVICES_START_FAILED: Universal Runtime 本地服务未能自动启动，需要修复。
zh-Hans.PRODUCT_HTTP_NOT_READY: 本地服务已经启动，但应用未能在预期时间内就绪。
zh-Hans.PORT_19093_CONFLICT: 另一个程序占用了 Universal Runtime 的本地服务端口。关闭冲突程序后再重试。
zh-Hans.WINDOWS_UNSUPPORTED: 当前 Windows 版本不受这个 Universal Runtime 版本支持。
